apps.name: ApneaTrainer
apps.subtitle: Free apnea breath training for iOS
apps.localizedDescription:
ApneaTrainer is a free, open-source apnea breath training app for iOS.

Features:

• O2, CO2, Mix & First Contraction training tables
• Custom table builder with configurable hold/recovery times
• Clean countdown timer with audio cues
• Multi-language support (English, Polish, Swedish, Russian)
• iOS 15.0+

privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Apnea Trainer uses the microphone for breath detection.
